notes: DiscoFlate v3.56.1 — an empty scene group now actually persists. Groups used to be inferred from the overlays carrying the name, so a group with nothing in it only existed in the browser until you refreshed — which is why a freshly-made 'Intro' kept vanishing from the Go Live dropdown. A scene now owns its group names properly, so an empty group is saved, survives a reload, and shows up everywhere immediately. Renaming and hiding follow it correctly, and scenes made before this still work.
